metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in Argentina's Salta Province from December 2000 to December 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset which tracks forest loss from 2000-2023 - Focus on Salta Province, Argentina - Compare forest cover in December 2000 (baseline) vs December 2019 - Need to get the administrative boundary for Salta Province 2. Masking strategy: - Hansen dataset has 'treecover2000' (% tree cover in year 2000) - 'loss' band indicates forest loss (binary: 1=loss occurred) - 'lossyear' band indicates year of loss (0-23 for 2000-2023) - Filter loss to years 1-19 (2001-2019) since we're comparing 2000 to 2019 - Use tree cover threshold (typically >30% is considered forest) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Forest cover in 2000 exists, no loss detected → Answer B (no decrease) - Valid Positive (A): Forest loss detected between 2000-2019 → Answer A (yes, decrease) - C1: No data for region - C2: After masking, no valid pixels - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const salta = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Argentina'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Salta') )); const geom = salta.geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // 3. Processing // Tree cover in 2000 (threshold: >30% is forest) const treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); const forestMask2000 = treecover2000.gt(30); // Forest loss from 2001-2019 (lossyear: 1-19) const loss = hansen.select('loss'); const lossyear = hansen.select('lossyear'); const loss2001to2019 = loss.and(lossyear.gte(1)).and(lossyear.lte(19)); // Calculate forest area in 2000 const forestArea2000 = forestMask2000.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const totalForest2000 = forestArea2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); // Calculate forest loss area 2001-2019 const lossArea = loss2001to2019.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const totalLoss = lossArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('loss'); // Count valid pixels const pixelCount = forestMask2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); // 4. Get results const forest2000_val = await totalForest2000.getInfo(); const loss_val = await totalLoss.getInfo(); const pixels = await pixelCount.getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Salta Province Forest Analysis (2000-2019)`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixels}`); if (pixels === null || pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (forest2000_val === null || loss_val === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } const forest2000_ha = (forest2000_val / 10000).toFixed(0); const loss_ha = (loss_val / 10000).toFixed(0); const loss_pct = ((loss_val / forest2000_val) * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Forest cover 2000: ${forest2000_ha} ha`); console.log(`Forest loss 2001-2019: ${loss_ha} ha`); console.log(`Loss percentage: ${loss_pct}%`); if (loss_val > 0) { console.log('Forest cover decreased significantly'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No forest loss detected'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
